queries.incorrect: SELECT SUM(i.Total) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId;

interpretation: The incorrect join repeats each invoice total for every matching line. A query can execute successfully and still overstate the requested measure. Equivalent results are accepted without demanding identical SQL text.
limits: This verifies computational behaviour, not improved student learning, causal educational effects or a guaranteed assignment grade.
